cases.title: Create a single note successfully
cases.description: Click the "Add note" button (data-testid="add-note-button") and verify that a new note element with the class "note" is appended to the document body, containing a visible, empty <textarea> (data-testid="note-textarea").

cases.title: Support rapid multiple clicks on Add note button
cases.description: Perform multiple rapid clicks on the "Add note" button (data-testid="add-note-button") and verify that each click creates a separate note appended to the document body, each containing its own unique textarea.

cases.title: Real-time Markdown rendering for valid syntax
cases.description: Verify that typing valid Markdown syntax (e.g., # Heading, **bold**, _italic_, [link](...)) in the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") dynamically renders the corresponding HTML formatting in real-time within the main display area (data-testid="note-main"), and the changes are immediately saved to local storage.

cases.title: Handling invalid Markdown syntax without crashing
cases.description: Verify that inputting invalid Markdown syntax (e.g., unmatched **) does not cause application errors or crashes, and upon exiting edit mode by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button"), the raw input is correctly displayed while changes persist in local storage.

cases.title: Verify initial edit mode and mode toggling functionality
cases.description: Verify that upon clicking the 'Add note' button, the note immediately enters edit mode where the textarea (data-testid='note-textarea') is visible and the main content area (data-testid='note-main') is hidden. Clicking the 'Edit' button (data-testid='edit-note-button') toggles between view and edit modes, displaying formatted content and hiding the textarea in view mode, and vice versa in edit mode.

cases.title: Verify automatic saving to local storage during editing
cases.description: Verify that all changes typed into the textarea during note editing are automatically saved to local storage, preserving the note's state across sessions.

cases.title: Delete note removes it from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Click the "Delete" button (data-testid="delete-note-button") on an existing note. Verify that the targeted note element is immediately removed from the document DOM and the corresponding entry is removed from localStorage.

cases.title: Load existing notes from localStorage on page load
cases.description: Verify that when the page loads with saved notes in localStorage, the app dynamically creates a note div for each entry containing the tools, main content area, and textarea, with the main content displayed and the textarea hidden by default for non-empty notes.

cases.title: Handle empty localStorage on page load
cases.description: Verify that when the page loads and localStorage contains no notes or is empty, no notes are rendered on the webpage.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are clear, distinct, cover all requirements properly, and are fully testable without any blockers.
All requirements and test cases are well-structured, consistent, and fully testable. No blockers identified.

analysis.analysis: The requirements outline a Notes App with functionality for creating notes via 'Add note' button (id='add', class='add', data-testid='add-note-button'), editing and rendering Markdown content with real-time updates and fallback for invalid syntax, toggling between edit and view modes using the 'Edit' button (data-testid='edit-note-button'), deleting notes via 'Delete' button (data-testid='delete-note-button'), and persisting/loading states via localStorage. Scenarios span normal user flows (single note creation, editing, toggling modes, deletion, persistence), edge/boundary cases (rapid clicking, empty vs non-empty notes loaded from storage, invalid markdown strings), and abnormal cases (empty localStorage on load).

gaps.rationale: Requirement 5 states that for notes that have no content, the application should instead show the textarea and hide the main div. The accepted cases cover general loading of saved notes and empty localStorage, but omit the specific scenario where a stored note has empty content.

output.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1: Normal scenario: Click the 'Add note' button (data-testid='add-note-button', id='add', class='add') once to append a <div> with class 'note' containing a visible, empty <textarea> (data-testid='note-textarea') to the document body. Edge/Boundary scenario: Perform multiple rapid clicks on the 'Add note' button to create multiple separate notes simultaneously, each containing its own textarea. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2: Normal scenario: Type valid Markdown (e.g., # Heading, **bold**, _italic_, [link](...)) into the textarea (data-testid='note-textarea') and verify real-time dynamic HTML rendering in the main display area (data-testid='note-main') along with immediate persistence to local storage. Edge/Boundary scenario: Input complex or invalid Markdown (e.g., unmatched **) and verify the application does not crash, displays raw input, and handles exit from edit mode via the 'Edit' button (data-testid='edit-note-button'). Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3: Normal scenario: Upon page load and creating a new note via the 'Add note' button, the note immediately enters edit mode with the textarea visible and main content area hidden; clicking the 'Edit' button toggles between view mode (main content visible, textarea hidden) and edit mode (textarea visible, main content hidden) while automatically saving changes to local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4: Normal scenario: Click the 'Delete' button (data-testid='delete-note-button') associated with a specific note to immediately remove that note element from the DOM and its corresponding entry from localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5: Normal scenario: Load the webpage with saved notes in localStorage, dynamically creating elements for each note with class 'note', a tools div containing 'Edit' (data-testid='edit-note-button') and 'Delete' (data-testid='delete-note-button') buttons, a main div (data-testid='note-main'), and a textarea (data-testid='note-textarea'), where notes with content display in the main div with the textarea hidden by default. Abnormal scenario: Load the webpage when localStorage is completely empty, ensuring no notes are shown. Actionable missing scenario (Edge): Load notes from localStorage that have no content, ensuring the application shows the textarea and hides the main div for immediate editing.
